announcements.headline: Phase Two Uranium Drilling & Webinar
announcements.insight: Phase Two uranium drilling follows the maiden discovery in October. This confirms progression of the ULG target defined earlier this year.

announcements.headline: CEO Interview: Uranium Discovery & Uranium Market
announcements.insight: The CEO interview follows the maiden drilling confirmation in October. Shareholders should watch for further exploration updates.

announcements.headline: Maiden Drilling Confirms Uranium Discovery at ULG
announcements.insight: Uranium intersected along 2.9 km of paleochannel confirms the extensive system defined at ULG target in September, validating the exploration strategy.

announcements.headline: Uranium Intersected Along 2.9 km Of Paleochannel
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources confirms an extensive uranium system at its ULG target. This drilling result follows earlier updates on Namibian operations and defines the resource potential.

announcements.headline: Extensive Uranium System Defined at ULG Target
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources confirms an extensive uranium system at its ULG target, following earlier reports of drilling underway in Namibia.

announcements.headline: Admission to OTCID Basic Market in United States
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources lists in a US OTC market. This follows recent operational updates in Namibia and Stonepark.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results confirm shareholder approval of proposals. This follows earlier notices regarding the annual report and operational updates in Namibia and Stonepark Zinc.

announcements.headline: Stonepark Zinc Update: New Zone Discovered
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources reports a new zone discovery at Stonepark Zinc. This follows Namibia uranium drilling updates and annual results, indicating ongoing exploration activity.

announcements.headline: Namibia Uranium Drilling Underway
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources (CDI) has commenced drilling in Namibia. This operational update follows the publication of its annual results and accounts in June.

announcements.headline: Rescheduling of Investor Webcast
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources has rescheduled its investor webcast, originally notified in June. Shareholders should check for a new date to hear the preliminary results discussed in the earlier announcement.

announcements.headline: Publication of Annual Report and Accounts
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources publishes its Annual Report following the June preliminary results. Shareholders should review the full accounts for detailed financial performance.

announcements.headline: Notice of Investor Webcast
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources is hosting an investor webcast following its preliminary results. Shareholders should watch for management commentary on the reported figures.

announcements.headline: Preliminary Results for Year Ended 31 Dec 2025
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources has released preliminary results for the year ended 31 Dec 2025. This follows the June 2026 appointment of joint brokers.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Joint Broker
announcements.insight: Arkle Resources has appointed joint brokers. This board change may affect future corporate actions.
